subject.title: Improve read tool handling for binary document formats (.docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx) & Avoid Token Waste on Binary Read

question: Should the read tool add a narrow safe fallback for PDF/Office-style binary documents now, or should this wait for broader document parsing/provider-native file design?
rationale: The source gap is real, but fallback messaging versus automatic parsing changes the read-tool contract and may overlap broader document/file capability work.

options.title: Approve narrow fallback guard
options.body: Add MIME/extension detection for known binary document formats and return a clear unsupported/read-with-parser message before text decoding.

options.title: Fold into broader document work
options.body: Leave this issue open but route implementation through the shared document extraction or provider-native file design instead of changing read alone.

options.title: Add native parsing
options.body: Implement parser-backed extraction only after maintainers approve dependencies, resource limits, and security boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow fallback guard
recommendation.body: Add MIME/extension detection for known binary document formats and return a clear unsupported/read-with-parser message before text decoding.

likelyOwner.reason: Current source and blame place the active read-tool implementation and wrapper on this person's recent area work.
